questions.question: What chemical substance is the genetic material in living organisms made of?
What scientific term is used to describe the entire collection of DNA found within a cell?
Which of the following best describes the shape of a DNA molecule?
Why can we sometimes see DNA with the unaided eye during a school extraction experiment?
options: DNA molecules are naturally larger than animal cells
The extraction process dyes the DNA a bright red colour
Large clumps of DNA are formed when many molecules are extracted together
A microscope is always required to see any extracted DNA

questions.question: In what tightly-packed structures is a cell's genome stored?
How many pairs of chromosomes are typically found in the nucleus of a normal human body cell?
What are the specific sections of DNA that contain instructions for inherited features called?
What is the main function of non-coding DNA?
options: It stores instructions for building structural proteins
It controls when the information in genes is used
It converts sugars into usable cellular energy
It is waste material with no cellular function

questions.question: Where is the genetic material stored in plant, animal, and fungi cells?
Where do bacteria, which lack a nucleus, store their genetic material?
What is the biological process called when features are passed from parents to their offspring?
Which of the following is true about offspring from sexual reproduction (excluding identical twins)?
options: They are always completely identical to one of their parents
They usually vary and are not identical to their parents or siblings
They inherit all of their features from only the mother
They do not share any features with their parents

questions.question: Why can features caused by lifestyle or the environment, like a scar, not be inherited by offspring?
options: They are not stored in the genetic material of the parents
They are too small to be passed on by cells
The offspring's body automatically repairs environmental changes
They are only stored in the blood cells

questions.question: Which pair of features correctly categorises a genetic feature and an environmental feature?
options: Height (environmental only) and skin colour (environmental only)

questions.question: Whose team in London used X-rays to produce an image of a DNA molecule in 1952?
Who used the X-ray picture evidence from Franklin's group to complete a model of the double helix structure of DNA?
options: Robert Hooke and Antonie van Leeuwenhoek
Charles Darwin and Alfred Russel Wallace
